page_title: HEI 1-1 EIN | Heidenheim v Eintracht Frankfurt 01/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
90+1' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) is substituted due to injury. Frank Schmidt gives a chance to Adam Kolle.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
87' One of the players from Heidenheim times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Eintracht Frankfurt comes to nothing.
83' The corner is swung in but Eintracht Frankfurt can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
80' Eintracht Frankfurt are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes onto the pitch for Elye Wahi.
76' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Ansgar Knauff will be replaced by Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt).
75' An attempted cross from Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) is cleared.
74' Eintracht Frankfurt keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
70' That's the end of the game for Budu Zivzivadze, who is replaced by Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim).
70' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Stefan Schimmer is replaced by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Julian Niehues trots off the pitch and is replaced by Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
70' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
70' Eintracht Frankfurt take a short corner kick.
69' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar!
66' It's a nice effort by Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Michael Zetterer. Easy save.
63' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Omar Haktab Traore comes onto the pitch to replace him.
63' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Nathaniel Brown.
63' Substitution. Ritsu Doan is replaced by Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt).
63' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
62' A cross from Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
60' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
58' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
58' Wonderful movement by Heidenheim. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
55' 1 - 1 Goal! Nathaniel Brown picks out Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the bottom left corner with a header from close range. 1:1.
54' Eintracht Frankfurt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

52' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) squanders a clear opportunity to score. He was one-on-one with Michael Zetterer on the edge of the box and attempted to put the ball inside the left post, but was denied by a terrific save.
52' The referee points to the corner flag and Heidenheim will take a corner.
50' Eintracht Frankfurt exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.
47' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) only hits the crossbar with a bullet header!
46' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

43' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
39' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

36' Eintracht Frankfurt slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
34' None of the Eintracht Frankfurt players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
34' Eintracht Frankfurt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
32' 1 - 0 Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
31' A player from Eintracht Frankfurt pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Heidenheim are awarded the free kick.
29' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Christian Dingert ignores the protests.

28' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Eintracht Frankfurt are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
26' Dino Toppmoller is forced to make a change. Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Mario Gotze.
23' Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a goal ruled out for offside!
23' A cross from a corner kick by Eintracht Frankfurt is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
20' One of the Heidenheim players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. That's a free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
19' Heidenheim keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
17' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.

15' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
13' The resulting set piece from Heidenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
13' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Good work from Heidenheim as they win a corner.
13' The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a throw-in.
11' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
11' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) and Arijon Ibrahimovic are exchanging a few passes as if neither of them want to be the one to start a new attack.
9' A pass from Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) is intercepted by Diant Ramaj and the move breaks down.
9' Eintracht Frankfurt seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
7' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Eintracht Frankfurt.
6' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
5' Eintracht Frankfurt are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

4' Heidenheim are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
3' The ball has crossed the sideline. Heidenheim are taking a throw-in.
2' A cross by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Heidenheim have a goal ruled out for offside!
Heidenheim will kick-off.
Christian Dingert was nominated as the referee for this game.
